      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Field α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] (k n : ℕ),\n  ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ioo k n, (↑i ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ 2 / (↑k + 1)",
      "informal_description": "For any natural numbers $k$ and $n$, the sum $\\sum_{i = k+1}^{n-1} \\frac{1}{i^2}$ is less than or equal to $\\frac{2}{k + 1}$.",

      "informal_description": "For any natural number $n$, it holds that $n \\leq \\sqrt{n} \\cdot \\sqrt{n} + \\sqrt{n} + \\sqrt{n}$.",

items.informal_description: For any natural number $ N $, the Roth number $ \text{rothNumberNat}(N) $, which denotes the maximum size of a subset of $ \{0, 1, \ldots, N-1\} $ containing no three distinct elements forming an arithmetic progression, satisfies $ \text{rothNumberNat}(N) \leq N $.
